checks.assumptions: z=x1+i*x2, barz=x1-i*x2, real Euclidean metric, symmetric contravariant tensor with T11=a,T12=T21=b,T22=c.
derivation: The inverse Jacobian gives g_{z barz}=g_{barz z}=1/2 and zero same-coordinate entries, so g_ab*T^{ab}=T^{z barz}=a+c. The written trace equality needs no extra factor under these stated assumptions.

Partial_z=(partial_1-i partial_2)/2 and partial_barz=(partial_1+i partial_2)/2. Exact linear coefficients give partial_z*T^{zz}+partial_barz*T^{barz z}=(partial_1*a+partial_2*b)+i*(partial_1*b+partial_2*c).

With zero mixed component and ordinary conservation, partial_z*T^{zz}=0 and partial_barz*T^{barz barz}=0. This is the opposite dependence to (11) for the source labels T=T^{zz}, barT=T^{barz barz}. A different unannounced convention remains possible; source labels and (11) are unchanged.

derivation: The central term gives c/2 times the third derivative of z^{n+1} divided by 3!: c(n+1)n(n-1)w^{n-2}/12. Outer residue is nonzero exactly when n+m=0, producing c(n^3-n)/12.
The second-order pole gives 2(n+1)L_{n+m}; integrating the T-prime term by parts gives -(n+m+2)L_{n+m}. Their sum is (n-m)L_{n+m}.

Thus the signs and coefficient in (21) agree conditionally with (20). This computation does not supply the absent first-variable subscript in the second factor of (16), nor identify a crossed-out word.
